# David Wilson

> Product builder and two-time founder-CEO.

## About

My buddy Ross and I started building software in 9th grade, modding video games before either of us could code, and later founded two companies together:

- **Cape Networks**, acquired by HPE Aruba. Network monitoring hardware and software: >$10M revenue, used by 2,000+ customers including Microsoft, Home Depot, and Disney. After the acquisition, I ran the business inside Aruba as Senior Director of Product Management.
- **Hunch**: started as a data tool, became an AI workflow builder, then autonomous agents. One project reached 330K users in two weeks. We wound the company down in 2025.

Today I'm at Hex, where the cofounders brought me in to work out their next dashboard builder. I took our generative data apps from first prototype to launch in two months, including building the evals. Since then I've worked on the last mile: the AI builds the app, but people still need precise control over the details. I also hold the dubious distinction of being the company's top AI spender.

I'm from Cape Town and have lived on four continents. I now live in San Francisco with my family.
